labels.comments: Amanda was very helpful and responsive, whenever I had questions. I love the location of the building. It's right across the station/arena and close to so many things and walking distance. There's a grocery store downstairs which is a plus! The place is super clean and it's a secured building as well. The view from the balcony, is breathtaking and I sat out there many times just taking in the view. Overall, it was a great stay. Thank you so much Amanda! I would recommend this place.
labels.note: Khen host Amanda phản hồi nhanh, vị trí đối diện nhà ga và siêu thị, căn hộ sạch sẽ, an ninh và tầm nhìn đẹp.

labels.comments: Cheryl’s place was exactly what we wanted in the city! It was gorgeous, clean and perfectly sized for the two of us. I also loved that they had oat milk for latte’s and snacks. The bed was comfortable and loved that they had a steamer for our nicer outfits. The location couldn’t be better - You can walk to tons of shops, cafes, restaurants and public transportation. It’s also on a beautiful, quiet street. Would recommend this spot to anyone and hope to visit again in the future!
labels.note: Khen chỗ ở đẹp, sạch sẽ, giường êm, chuẩn bị sẵn đồ ăn nhẹ và vị trí yên tĩnh gần phương tiện công cộng.

labels.comments: I had a fantastic stay at Kallin and Faiza's place! The space was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Faiza was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and made sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I highly recommend this listing to anyone looking for a great place to stay. Would definitely return!
labels.note: Khen không gian sạch sẽ, ấm cúng đúng mô tả và host Faiza hiếu khách, phản hồi nhanh.

labels.comments: A sincere thank you to Nick who helped me whenever I sent a message! Amazing Airbnb with an even more amazing view. Right in the middle of downtown Toronto with scotiabank and Roger’s across the street. Absolutely great place to stay!
labels.note: Khen host Nick nhiệt tình hỗ trợ, tầm nhìn đẹp và vị trí trung tâm đối diện Scotiabank Arena và Rogers Centre.

labels.comments: David's condo was perfect for our visit. Very clean and had all necessary items.  The location could not have been better for our stay. Close to our event as well as great restaurants and shopping. David is a superb host and very responsive. Highly recommend this condo. Would definitely stay here again!
labels.note: Khen căn hộ sạch sẽ, đủ tiện nghi, vị trí thuận tiện và host David rất chu đáo.

labels.comments: We had zero problems; the apartment was clean and modern. Max quickly answered my questions. Highly recommended.
labels.note: Không gặp vấn đề gì, căn hộ sạch sẽ hiện đại và host Max trả lời nhanh.

labels.comments: As always, Melissa provided excellent accommodation during my stay at her Airbnb. I look forward to staying there again!
labels.note: Khách quen khen chỗ ở của Melissa tuyệt vời và mong muốn quay lại.

labels.comments: very responsive & the place was spotless! 10/10 stay. would definitely stay again!
labels.note: Đánh giá 10/10, khen host phản hồi nhanh và chỗ ở cực kỳ sạch sẽ.

labels.comments: Booked Nasrin's place for my parents for over 2 months. They had a great stay. Nasrin was very friendly and readily helpful. Would highly recommend
labels.note: Đặt cho bố mẹ ở hơn 2 tháng rất hài lòng, khen host Nasrin thân thiện và hay giúp đỡ.

labels.comments:
This place is fantastic! So clean in rooms & shared spaces with All the amenities you could need including complementary multi flavoured coffee, and tea, complementary pop and water and candies in the rooms.
Really comfortable beds with high end bedding . TVs in every room. Soundproofing is very good in the front rooms overlooking the Danforth, much quieter than I would’ve expected. The back room overlooks, a gorgeous deck, which was beautifully covered with snow, but in the summer will be also beautiful. The kitchen and living room layout is large with large seating area in both spaces making it very conducive for multiple guests. It is a two minute walk to the subway, so it is very accessible to get anywhere in the city. This place is a gem. I look forward to visiting again. The hosts and their little son are beautiful people. Thanks so much!
labels.note: Khen toàn diện về độ sạch, tiện nghi đồ uống miễn phí, cách âm tốt, gần tàu điện ngầm và gia đình host thân thiện.

labels.comments: Our stay at Sandeep's place was absolutely fantastic! The unit was spotless and incredibly well-maintained, making us feel right at home. Sandeep was an exceptional host, super responsive and attentive to our needs, which made the entire experience seamless. The location is unbeatable, right in the heart of downtown Toronto, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and public transit. We couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Highly recommend!
labels.note: Khen căn hộ sạch sẽ bảo trì tốt, host Sandeep chu đáo và vị trí trung tâm Toronto thuận tiện.

labels.comments: A great spot for a fun weekend away or a solo-traveller in for a wedding. Everything that you would need for you as a home-away-from-home. Clean, bright, the wondrous terrace was a perfect spot to end your evenings. There's a convenient store immediately next door for any incidentals. Was a great experience.
labels.note: Khen chỗ ở sạch sẽ, sáng sủa, sân thượng đẹp và ngay cạnh cửa hàng tiện lợi.

labels.comments: We had a great stay. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the decor throughout the space was beautiful and thoughtfully done. The view of the skyline was stunning, especially at night. The kitchen was well stocked with everything we needed to cook meals, which made it feel like a home away from home. Would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a cozy, stylish, and convenient place to stay.
labels.note: Khen giường êm, trang trí đẹp, tầm nhìn thành phố về đêm ấn tượng và bếp đầy đủ đồ nấu nướng.

labels.comments: It is a “ok” house but it seems too old and lack of maintenance, we found sone hair in the bathroom and a plastic cup under the curtains in the main suite , the stairs are slippery and not so good for kids even seniors .
labels.note: Phàn nàn nhà cũ thiếu bảo trì, còn tóc trong phòng tắm và cốc nhựa dưới rèm, cầu thang trơn nguy hiểm.

labels.comments: Very responsive hosts even when there was a small problem with the check in they helped us immediately and it didn’t even feel like a problem. The room was clean and matched the description. Location was perfect as well.
labels.note: Host phản hồi nhanh xử lý ngay sự cố nhỏ lúc check-in, phòng sạch đúng mô tả và vị trí hoàn hảo.

labels.comments:
Every thing was good except there was stain on the fitted sheet and the flat sheets. So basically all the sheets had stain and didn’t use them at all.
Bathroom sink is bit small and water retention on the top of the sink and it drips all over the floor was bit annoying.
labels.note: Nhận xét mọi thứ ổn nhưng phàn nàn rõ về ga giường có vết bẩn không dùng được và bồn rửa nhỏ đọng nước chảy ra sàn.

labels.comments: Perfect location, fantastic view, nice and spacious place. Desmond was very friendly,  responsive and made our stay very pleasant.
labels.note: Khen vị trí hoàn hảo, tầm nhìn đẹp, không gian rộng rãi và host Desmond thân thiện.

labels.comments: Great place to stay and would book again. Very clean, quiet and comfortable. Jeffrey was very responsive and answered all of my questions within minutes. Very flexible when it came to checking in early. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place while visiting Toronto!
labels.note: Khen chỗ ở sạch, yên tĩnh, thoải mái và host Jeffrey phản hồi nhanh, linh hoạt cho nhận phòng sớm.

labels.comments: our group had a fantastic stay! Nana was very accommodating and responsive to all our products requests! would definitely stay here again!
labels.note: Cả nhóm rất hài lòng, khen host Nana nhiệt tình hỗ trợ mọi yêu cầu và chắc chắn sẽ quay lại.

labels.comments: We had a pleasant stay in Daniel's apartment. The flat is located in a quiet neighborhood close to a busier street with streetcar lines, restaurants and shops. It is very spacious and well equipped, only the kitchen is bit worn out. Downtown can be reached by public transport in around 45-60 minutes. Daniel is a really nice and communicative host.
labels.note: Khen căn hộ rộng rãi đủ đồ, khu phố yên tĩnh và host Daniel thân thiện nhưng nhận xét bếp hơi cũ kỹ.
